title: 9:16 vertical, ultra-realistic photograp
prompt:
9:16 vertical, ultra-realistic photography, Korean idol private photobook aesthetic, soft-glow CCD snapshot, early-2000s Korean-Japanese camera roll style, soft intimate portrait.
A clearly adult Korean female idol, aged 23–27, with a tall, well-proportioned figure, a slim waist, and naturally balanced body proportions. Her skin is cool-toned, fair, and luminous, with realistic, delicate skin texture preserved. She has smooth deep-black long hair naturally falling over her shoulders and back, with slightly tousled ends and a few loose strands framing her face. Her face is small and refined, with cat-like eyes and a calm, languid expression that carries a subtle sense of intimacy.
Her makeup is a slightly more polished Korean idol version of a private photobook look: a light, translucent base, delicate highlights on the nose bridge and center of the face, eye makeup in muted rose-brown and dusty pink tones, softly elongated outer corners without appearing too sharp, a slight shimmer under-eye accent, clearly separated lashes, a soft peach-pink blush on the cheeks, and glossy rosy nude lips with a glass-like finish. The overall makeup feels fresh, soft, and translucent, while still being more camera-ready than ordinary daily makeup. She wears small silver earrings and a delicate necklace, adding to the Y2K Korean private snapshot atmosphere.
She is wearing a slightly loose cream-white lightweight knit top, with the neckline naturally slipping a little to reveal her collarbones and shoulder line. On the lower body, she wears plain white fitted triangle briefs, simple in design with no patterns, text, or brand logos. The overall styling feels clean, light, and slightly intimate, like Korean idol off-duty homewear styling.
The subject is kneeling at the center of a white bed, with both legs naturally folded beneath her and the tops of her feet resting against the mattress. Her upper body leans slightly forward, with a naturally elongated waist and back line. One hand lightly supports her on the bed in front of her, while the other rests naturally near the front of her thigh or gently adjusts the hem of her top. Her head tilts slightly downward, then she lifts her eyes subtly toward the camera. Her expression is restrained, quiet, slightly languid, and faintly flirtatious, like a close-up private snapshot taken by a friend on a quiet afternoon.
The setting is a bright yet soft hotel bedroom or private apartment bedroom, with slightly wrinkled white bedsheets, a light beige wall in the background, and sheer white curtains. Soft afternoon natural light enters from a side window, combined with a subtle CCD on-camera fill flash, creating gentle highlight bloom and soft-focus glow. The overall image is low-contrast, low-saturation, slightly overexposed, with a faint cool digital color cast, while preserving fine CCD noise, grain, slight softness, and the imperfect framing of a casual snapshot.
Soft, dreamy, intimate, Korean idol private photobook mood, realistic anatomy, natural hands and legs, no text, no watermark.
